generation.notes: Written by a sub-agent of the orchestrating Claude Code session from the final brief, with no person involved. Points are cut to the distance once per worker; per item the coordinates are quantised, ordered along a Morton curve, delta-encoded and packed with zlib. precision 1 to 4 means grid cells of 8, 4, 2 and 1 cm.

notes: knob precision has no effect on the processing time
